# read in metadata

```{r}
# get mitogenome database metadata
stats_plus_metadata <- readxl::read_xlsx("mitogenome_database_metadata.xlsx", sheet = 1, na = c("", " ", "NA"))

# remove whitespace
stats_plus_metadata <- stats_plus_metadata %>%
  mutate(ID_number = str_replace_all(ID_number, " ", ""),
                                  .keep = "unused"
         )


# load in full sequence dataset metadata
metadata_full <- readxl::read_xlsx("metadata_U.xlsx", sheet = 1, na = c("", " ", "NA"))
metadata_full <- metadata_full %>% filter(!is.na(sample_ID))

# create final taxa variables in metadata - when a nuclear DNA confirmed species identification exists, use it, otherwise use the previously determined species identification
metadata_taxa <- metadata_full %>% mutate(final_genus = case_when(is.na(nuclear_genus) ~ genus,
                                                    .default = nuclear_genus),
                                final_species = case_when(is.na(nuclear_genus) ~ species,
                                                      .default = nuclear_species),
                                .keep = "unused")
# remove whitespace
metadata_taxa <- metadata_taxa %>% mutate(f_genus = str_replace_all(final_genus, " ", ""),
                                f_species = str_replace_all(final_species, " ", ""),
                                number = str_replace_all(voucher_or_tissue_number, " ", ""),
                                .keep = "unused")

# create full_species_name variable
metadata_taxa <- metadata_taxa %>% 
  mutate(full_species_name = paste(f_genus, f_species, sep = "_"))
```

# geography vs completeness statistical analysis

```{r}
# create adjusted country groups
stats_plus_metadata_adjusted_country <- stats_plus_metadata %>% 
  mutate(country = case_when(geographic_region %in% c("East New Guinea", "Bismarck Archipelago") ~ "Papua\nNew Guinea",
                             geographic_region %in% c("Sulawesi", "Maluku Islands", "Indonesia", "West New Guinea") ~ "Indonesia",
                             geographic_region %in% c("Bougainville Island", "Solomon Islands") ~ "Solomon Is. +\nBougainville Is.",
                             .default = geographic_region)
         ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(country)) %>% 
  filter(c(country %in% c("Papua\nNew Guinea", "Indonesia", "Solomon Is. +\nBougainville Is.", "Australia"))) # retain only target regions

# retain required variables
stats_plus_metadata_adjusted_country <- stats_plus_metadata_adjusted_country %>% 
  select(sample_ID, approximate_genome_completeness, ID_number, species, country, specimen_type) %>% 
  rename(full_species_name = species,
         number = ID_number)

metadata_taxa_subset <- metadata_taxa %>% 
  select(sample_ID, full_species_name, number, Sahul_region, specimen_type)

# add failed samples as zeros (ignore missing novaehollandiae and Mesembriomys gouldii as many excluded due to low recovery given other high-recovery samples)
add_missing_mtDNA_save <- metadata_taxa_subset %>%
  filter(!(sample_ID %in% c(stats_plus_metadata$sample_ID))) %>% 
  filter(!(full_species_name %in% c("Pseudomys_novaehollandiae",
                                    "Mesembriomys_gouldii"))) %>% 
  filter(!(sample_ID %in% c("EC6_Pseudomys_delicatulus_M56791_WA_WarrambooCreek", "EC5_Leptomys_paulus_M23838"))) %>% #non rodent samples that were dropped, planigale and bird
  # remove any replicate samples which have mtDNA
  filter(!(number %in% stats_plus_metadata$ID_number)) %>% 
  group_by(number) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>% # ensure only one observation per individual specimen when multiple libraries per specimen
  mutate(approximate_genome_completeness = 0)

add_missing_mtDNA <- add_missing_mtDNA_save %>% 
  mutate(country = case_when(Sahul_region %in% c("East New Guinea", "Bismarck Archipelago") ~ "Papua\nNew Guinea",
                             Sahul_region %in% c("Sulawesi", "Maluku Islands", "Indonesia", "West New Guinea") ~ "Indonesia",
                             Sahul_region %in% c("Bougainville Island", "Solomon Islands") ~ "Solomon Is. +\nBougainville Is.",
                             .default = Sahul_region)
         ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(country)) %>% 
  filter(c(country %in% c("Papua\nNew Guinea", "Indonesia", "Solomon Is. +\nBougainville Is.", "Australia"))) # retain only target regions

stats_plus_metadata_adjusted_country <- bind_rows(stats_plus_metadata_adjusted_country, add_missing_mtDNA)

stats_plus_metadata_adjusted_country %>% group_by(country) %>% summarise(n = n())
```

```{r}
oneway.test(approximate_genome_completeness ~ country, data = stats_plus_metadata_adjusted_country, var.equal = FALSE)

# ANOVA is significant (completeness depends on geography)

# isolate significance post-HOC (use Games-Howell to account for unequal sampling and variance)
rstatix::games_howell_test(data = stats_plus_metadata_adjusted_country, approximate_genome_completeness ~ country, detailed = T) %>% 
  filter(p.adj.signif != "ns")

stats_plus_metadata_adjusted_country %>%
  group_by(country) %>% 
  summarise(mean = mean(approximate_genome_completeness),
            SD = sd(approximate_genome_completeness))
```


# historical vs modern specimens statistical analysis

```{r}
historical_vs_modern <- bind_rows(stats_plus_metadata, add_missing_mtDNA_save)

stat_test <- wilcox.test((historical_vs_modern %>% filter(specimen_type == "historical"))$approximate_genome_completeness,
            (historical_vs_modern %>% filter(specimen_type != "historical"))$approximate_genome_completeness)

stat_test
stat_test$p.value

historical_vs_modern %>% 
            group_by(specimen_type) %>% 
            summarise(count = n(),
            mean = mean(approximate_genome_completeness),
            SD = sd(approximate_genome_completeness))
```

# phylogenetic information content statistical analyses

```{r}
# load data
reciprocally_monophyletic <- read_csv("reciprocal_monophyly_for_correlation_plots.csv")
```


## Reciprocal Monophyly vs Bootstrap score

```{r}
# bootstrap vs RM
bootstrap_RM_model <- lm(proportion ~ average_bootstrap_score,
                         data = reciprocally_monophyletic %>%
                           filter(length == "200"))

bootstrap_RM_model

paste("R_squared =", signif(broom::glance(bootstrap_RM_model)$adj.r.squared, 2))
paste("p =", signif(broom::glance(bootstrap_RM_model)$p.value, 2))
```


## Reciprocal Monophyly vs Parsimony

```{r}
# RM vs parsimony sites
RM_site_model <- lm(proportion ~ parsimony_sites,
                    data = reciprocally_monophyletic %>%
                    filter(length == "200"),
                    weights = total_clades)

RM_site_model

paste("R_squared =", signif(broom::glance(RM_site_model)$adj.r.squared, 2))
paste("p =", signif(broom::glance(RM_site_model)$p.value, 2))
```

### Reciprocal monophyly vs Branch Length

```{r}
# Read in files
overall_reciprocal_monophyly <- read_csv("overall_reciprocal_monophyly_across_windows.csv")

# read divergence to sister clade calculated from time calibrated tree in Roycroft et al., 2022
nuclear_sister_divergences <- read_csv("divergence_to_sister_based_on_time_cal_tree_Roycroft_etal_2022.csv")
```

```{r}
# calculate clade RM proportion
clade_RM_proportion <- overall_reciprocal_monophyly %>% 
  filter(is.na(barcode), length == 200) %>% # retain only 200bp controlled windows
  # convert reciprocal monophyly to 0 and 1 rather than no and yes to enable calculation of proportion using mean
  mutate(reciprocal_monophyly = case_when(reciprocal_monophyly == "yes" ~ 1,
                                          .default = 0)) %>% 
  group_by(clade) %>% 
  summarise(proportion = mean(reciprocal_monophyly),
            num_windows = n_distinct(window),
            windows_included = num_windows/n_distinct((overall_reciprocal_monophyly %>% filter(is.na(barcode), length == 200))$window))
  
# join clade proportion to nuclear clade divergences
reciprocal_monophyly_by_divergence <- inner_join(nuclear_sister_divergences, clade_RM_proportion, join_by(clade))

# plot branch length against reciprocal monophyly
RM_divergence_model <- glm(proportion ~ length, 
                           data = reciprocal_monophyly_by_divergence,
                           weights = num_windows,
                           family = "quasibinomial")

p_value <- (broom::tidy(RM_divergence_model) %>% filter(term == "length"))$p.value

#Efron's Pseudo-R2
predicted <- predict(RM_divergence_model, type = "response")
r_squared <- 1 - (sum((RM_divergence_model$y - predicted)^2) / sum((RM_divergence_model$y - mean(RM_divergence_model$y))^2)) # 1 - SUM((yi - pred. yi)^2) / SUM((yi - mean(yi))^2)

r_squared <- signif(r_squared, 2)
p_value <- signif(p_value, 2)



RM_divergence_model

paste("R_squared =", r_squared)
paste("p =", p_value)
```

## Reciprocal monophyly vs Sequence Length

```{r}
# create loci_sequence region ID variable
reciprocally_monophyletic <- reciprocally_monophyletic %>% 
  mutate(loci_sequence_region_ID =
           case_when(!is.na(sequence_region_ID) ~ paste(loci, sequence_region_ID, sep = "_"),
                     .default = NA)) %>% 
  mutate(length = as.factor(length))

paired_windows <- reciprocally_monophyletic %>% 
  filter(length == "100" | length == "200") %>% 
  arrange(loci_sequence_region_ID, length) %>% 
  select(loci_sequence_region_ID, length, proportion) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = length,
              values_from = proportion)

save_RM_paired_windows <- paired_windows

paired_windows <- t.test(paired_windows$`100`, paired_windows$`200`, paired = T)

paired_windows
```
